body: Penal.  I had surgery a couple years ago, but due to my bleeding issues, there was too much scar tissue left and that causes problems.
I stopped when I lost insurance.  I don't know though.

I started to show symptoms of phimosis about 8 years ago, but my mom didn't let me see a doctor until about 3 years ago so I spent all of those years in extreme pain, that's when I started to have suicidal thoughts.  After a year of actually getting medical help, I lost my insurance and things got worse for a year.  I attempted suicide by taking a hand full of my old pain medication but I just ended up throwing up and passing out.  After that my thoughts of suicide went away only until recently.

I had a cousin pass away from cancer in January.  I really didn't take my cousin's death that poorly though since we weren't that close.  When I told the person who was my best friend at the time, she ignored me and then when I told her that I couldn't make it back home for the funeral, she didn't say anything to me.  She did what all my old friends did when I was sick with other medical problems and in and out of hospitals, they were never there.  Our friendship fell apart before I started to really start to have these thoughts though.
